title: The Paradise
plot_overview: Set in 1980s Secunderabad, the story follows a marginalised tribe facing discrimination as its members fight for citizenship. Under the guidance of an unexpected leader, the community confronts systemic oppression and challenges the forces that keep it excluded from equal recognition and rights.
will_you_like_this: You may like this if you value socially conscious dramas about marginalized communities and political struggle; Not for you if you prefer light, escapist entertainment or fast-paced action.
review_summary: Pros: socially relevant premise; period setting; community-focused story | Cons: limited review details; potentially heavy themes
